Urgot

ADC Sleeper

Poke ADC Urgot

How to play this build

Play around the combo: land the Corrosive Charge (E) to mark the target, and all your Acid Hunter (Q) auto-lock onto it for poke that never misses. Stack Manamune by spamming Q. In teamfights, the ult swaps your position with the enemy carry to drop it into your team: one of the best kidnap tools in the game.

Skill order

Max priority:

Q Cazador Ácido → E Carga Corrosiva Noxiana → W Capacitor de Terror

The ultimate (R) is always leveled at 6, 11 and 16.

Level 123456789101112131415161718
Q QQQQQ
W WWWWW
E EEEEE
R RRR
Why this order
Acid Hunter (Q) for homing poke; Corrosive Charge (E) second because it's the mark that makes Q auto-lock. W (shield) at 1 point.

Items and what they do

  1. Manamune AD and mana that grow as you spend mana; perfect for spell-spammers.
  2. The Black Cleaver AD and health; your hits stack armor shred on the target.
  3. Frozen Heart Armor, mana and CDR; aura that slows enemy attack speed.
  4. Mercury's Treads Boots with MR and tenacity (reduced CC duration).
  5. Randuin's Omen Health and armor; active AoE slow that also cuts attackers' attack speed.
  6. Frozen Mallet Lots of health and some AD; your auto-attacks slow the target (permaslow).

Masteries: how they work

In Season 3 you have up to 30 points (at level 30) to split across three trees: Offense (damage), Defense (durability) and Utility (mana, cooldown reduction and mobility). The notation 21/0/9 means 21 points in Offense, 0 in Defense and 9 in Utility.

Masteries
21/9/0 — Offense
Why this page
21/9/0 boosts Acid Hunter poke with some durability for its tanky nature.
